notes.title: BIG CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.notes:
New update!

I add:
A world map 1, to be able to repeat levels, for example to grab a musical note that was not grabbed before.
- 3 new bonus levels! They are unlocked according to how many musical notes you have grabbed. A level is unlocked: At 3 notes, at 6 notes and at 10 notes. These levels are more difficult than the rest, but they are optional.
- Along with the 3 levels, 3 new achievements! one for each extra level passed In addition to an extra achievement for talking to the cat that welcomes us into world 2.
- A glimpse of the world 2. There is still no level other than a welcome one, but it is a preview of the full game.
- More accessible assistance mode. In the escape menu you can activate the assistance mode so as not to die.
Note: With assist mode enabled, the "Speed ​​of Light" and "Tough as a Padlock" achievements cannot be achieved.
- Compatibility with some joysticks. In the pause menu with the escape key during the game, clicking the joystick activates a setting that works with some joysticks, more joysticks will be supported soon.

Thank you very much for your comments!
